# Football

<p class="sx-lede">I started in goal. Now I play central midfield for Bengaluru FC's youth side.</p>

Football has been the constant alongside everything else on this site. I joined the Bengaluru FC Soccer Schools in 2022 and play for Young Blues Elite FC at U17 and U19 level as a central midfielder, and I have been one of the team's rotational captains.

<p class="sx-label">The club</p>

## Competitive youth football in Bengaluru

Young Blues Elite FC is Bengaluru FC's elite youth team. I have played in the competitions it enters, including the Double Pass Development League (DPDL), the Karnataka State Football Association's Youth Premier League (U17) and the Bangalore District Football Association's B Division.
